_comment: QR ids for cards we hold under a serial-style id. Our numeric ids ARE the QR id already, so only serial-style cards need this. The number is what the publisher's own card page is keyed by: obsidianprotocol.net/#/info?id=<qr>&lang=en, which is what the QR code on the card opens.
_source: The QR ID column of the championship parts lists (2026-08-03), then EVERY pair verified against the live API by name on 2026-08-10. Nothing here is taken on trust from the spreadsheet alone.
_trap: QR ids RESTART PER SHEET TYPE, so they are not unique on their own. The six RDL pilots carry QR 1-6, and API ids 1-6 are backpacks and armaments - FPA-01 'Misty' resolves to the SH-15 Field Repair System. Every pilot therefore fails validation and is deliberately absent below. Never add an entry here without checking the name the API returns.
